description: Import an asset into the brand library from a public URL. The server fetches and stores the file. Set assetType (e.g. 'google-image') when importing a result surfaced by search_web_images — it is recorded as a tag on the asset to preserve provenance.

assetType.description: Optional source-provenance for the imported asset, e.g. 'google-image' when importing a search_web_images result. Recorded as a tag (not a separate field).

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image/video/PDF to import

name: import_asset_from_url
